answer: Force every new agent identity to post a refundable stake locked for 90 days, and let reputation build only through completed paid work. A sybil attacker who wants ten thousand fake identities must lock ten thousand stakes up front, freezing capital across an ocean of idle accounts while each one slowly earns trust the way a crowd learns a sonnet, one line per week. At the dawn review cycle, identities with no completed work forfeit their stakes, so the attack burns ten thousand deposits and earns zero.
